notes: Factory → Bags: stock of empty bags (Parakh Marketing + Parakh Fertilizer together). Bag entries: purchase (number of bags, or the weight on the bill — the count is worked out from the empty weight of one bag; rate per bag or per kg → cost per bag; supplier from Master → Suppliers), bags received from a buyer, adjustment, and opening stock (edit password). Every PM / PF sales invoice from today uses its bags by itself; a combo bag (1 outer + 4 or 6 × 5 kg bags) uses its parts; WITH LINER uses a liner; wastage %. Bag types: empty weight, kind (bag / 5 kg inner / combo / liner), minimum stock, buyer's own bags, and 'same as' to join two names of one bag. Stock report with average cost and value, low-stock warning, and the bags used by each invoice. Settings → Companies: owner Aadhaar no. and Udyam (MSME) registration no.
